title: link_hint: request
description: From v0.3: a decision attempt of the farm manager seat hints that a rejected proposal could have prevented an incident. The hint creates nothing: people with governance.attribute see it marked "manager's hint, not checked", and only a person creates a candidate through P2 attribution.create (GOV-39). At most 3 hints per tenant per week. Refusals: own_proposal, manager_restricted.

incident.description: An incident of the attempt's tenant.

proposal.description: A proposal of the same tenant that the commission rejected.
